subject.title: feat: show a relocating status footer on in-flight channel replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Telegram-only, transient progress-draft status line as a default-enabled feature, rather than the linked delivered-intermediate-reply footer request?
rationale: The code intentionally changed from the requested delivery seam to a narrower preview seam, while also adding a new default-visible behavior for existing users; only maintainers can decide whether that product tradeoff and issue closure are acceptable.

options.title: Narrow and preserve existing output
options.body: Retitle and unlink the delivered-reply request, make the preview status line opt-in or otherwise preserve existing output, then add real Telegram proof.

options.title: Approve the new default
options.body: Explicitly accept the `activity` default for existing Telegram progress users, while still correcting the PR and linked-issue scope.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the preview-only version until maintainers choose whether the original delivered-message behavior needs a viable core seam.

recommendation.title: Narrow and preserve existing output
recommendation.body: Retitle and unlink the delivered-reply request, make the preview status line opt-in or otherwise preserve existing output, then add real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies steipete as the proposer and implementer of both the original delivery design and the later progress-draft redesign.
